name: pip-overlay
description: Always-on-top pill and card overlay for the pip orchestrator
author: somlunavat

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p bin && (swiftc -O native/clickwatch.swift -o bin/clickwatch || echo 'clickwatch not built: install Xcode command line tools for double-click-outside to close')
scripts.check: for f in *.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
